scientific_integrity: Definitions, fixed-space dimensions, characteristic-three Jordan blocks, maximal temporal orders and Möbius-inverted orbit populations are documented with a full proof and independently coded finite reproducibility checks.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to reversible loopless unweighted vertex-neighbor waves on \(K_{2r+1}\) with r disjoint edges deleted, \(r\ge2\), over finite fields of characteristic three. The finite tests are not substitutes for the all-size proof. Historical priority is qualified by inaccessible or unindexed sources; independent external validation has not occurred.
title: One-vertex deletion creates three exact ternary wave clocks on cocktail-party graphs
